events.title: Deliwhere? - Hotfix 0.0.3 (Multiplayer Stability, Physics & UI Polish)

events.title: Deliwhere? - Hotfix Update v0.0.2 (Multiplayer, Audio & Quality-of-Life)
events.summary: Hello Couriers! 🚚💨Thank you so much for jumping into Deliwhere? and delivering packages with us! Based on your detailed playtest reports and community feedback, we've deployed our first hotfix update focusing on multiplayer stability, audio clarity, visual polish, and gameplay improvements.Here is everything included in Hotfix v0.1.1:🛠️ MULTIPLAYER & STEAM LOBBY• Steam Lobby Invites: Fixed an issue where the lobby could get stuck after returning to the Main Menu, preventing new invite acceptance
